# Glossary

- **Tenant** — one customer account in Atlas; quotas apply per tenant.
- **Envelope** — the allowed pitch/roll region for the rover body (see [[rover/docs/attitude-limiter]]).
- **Frame** — one telemetry packet on the radio link.
- **Bring-up** — first power-on and smoke test of new hardware.
- **Cutoff** — the battery voltage at which the rover stops driving.
